name: Drifting Clouds
description: Soft procedural clouds drifting across a winter sky, drawn by a WebGL fragment shader.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for the wind and for how fast the clouds change shape. 0 holds them still.

props.name: coverage
props.description: How much of the sky is cloud, from 0 (clear) to 1 (overcast).

props.name: skyTop
props.description: Sky colour at the top. Without it, a pale winter blue by day and night navy in the dark theme. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: skyBottom
props.description: Sky colour at the horizon. Without it, near-snow by day and a faint blue glow at night.

props.name: cloudColor
props.description: Colour of the lit tops of the clouds. The undersides are mixed from it. Without it, cream-white by day and moonlit grey at night.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the sky. Other div props are passed through.
